Cột B: 68; 45; 30; 55.  4) Xoá các cột/ dòng mẫu thừa (Series 2, Series 3, Category còn lại) hoặc kéo khung xanh thu hẹp vùng dữ liệu.  5) Đóng cửa sổ dữ liệu.

cham.de_bai: In the “Get Involved” section, in the blank paragraph below the table, insert a Clustered Column chart that shows the “Recycling rate (%)” values for the first 4 items of the table: Paper (68), Glass (45), Plastic (30), Metal (55). Use “Recycling rate (%)” as the series name.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Save the heading and paragraphs of the “How Are Computers Used Today?” section as a Quick Part named “Computer Intro” in the Quick Part gallery. Accept all other default settings.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề và hai đoạn văn của section.  2) Insert > Quick Parts > Save Selection to Quick Part Gallery.  3) Name: Computer Intro; Gallery: Quick Parts > OK.

cham.de_bai: Save the heading and paragraphs of the “How Are Computers Used Today?” section as a Quick Part named “Computer Intro” in the Quick Part gallery. Accept all other default settings.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Use wildcards to find all instances of “Ms. Kim Akers” and “Miss Kim Akers” and replace them with “Kim Akers”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > tích Use wildcards.  2) Find what: <M[! ]@ (Kim Akers)   (M + một hay nhiều ký tự khác khoảng trắng, rồi tên người)  3) Replace with: \1 > Replace All > OK.  4) Kiểm tra: mọi chỗ "Ms. Kim Akers" và "Miss Kim Akers" chỉ còn "Kim Akers".

cham.de_bai: Use wildcards to find all instances of “Ms. Kim Akers” and “Miss Kim Akers” and replace them with “Kim Akers”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Limit formatting in the document to the recommended minimum set of styles. Do not enforce protection.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Formatting restrictions: tích Limit formatting to a selection of styles > Settings.  3) Bấm Recommended Minimum > OK (chọn No nếu hỏi xoá định dạng không cho phép). Không bấm Start Enforcing Protection.

cham.de_bai: Limit formatting in the document to the recommended minimum set of styles. Do not enforce protection.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Replace all instances of the Heading 3 style in the document with the Heading 2 style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > để trống Find what và Replace with.  2) Đặt con trỏ ở ô Find what > Format > Style > Heading 3 > OK.  3) Đặt con trỏ ở ô Replace with > Format > Style > Heading 2 > OK > Replace All.

cham.de_bai: Replace all instances of the Heading 3 style in the document with the Heading 2 style.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Mark the document as final.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: File > Info > Protect Document > Mark as Final > OK > OK.

cham.de_bai: Mark the document as final.
